# Srushti Hosting

> Srushti Hosting provides fast, secure & reliable Web Hosting, Domain Registration, Google Workspace, and SSL Security for growing businesses.

## Overview
Srushti Hosting delivers high-performance NVMe web hosting infrastructure, instant domain registration with full DNS management, official Google Workspace business emails, free SSL certificates, and zero-downtime website migrations backed by 24/7 technical support.

## Hosting Services & Pricing

### Shared Web Hosting Plans (NVMe SSD)
- **Starter Plan**: ₹349/month (or ₹279/month billed annually at ₹3,348/yr)
  - 5 GB SSD Storage, 1 Website, 5 Email Accounts, 50 GB Monthly Bandwidth, Free SSL Certificate, cPanel, Automated Daily Snapshots.
- **Business Plan** (Recommended): ₹799/month (or ₹639/month billed annually at ₹7,668/yr)
  - 15 GB SSD Storage, 5 Websites, Unlimited Email Accounts, Unmetered Bandwidth, Free SSL Certificate, Free Website Migration, 24/7 Priority Support.
- **Professional Plan**: ₹1,499/month (or ₹1,199/month billed annually at ₹14,388/yr)
  - 30 GB SSD Storage, Unlimited Websites, Unlimited Email Accounts, Unmetered Bandwidth, Free SSL Certificate, Free Dedicated IP, Free Website Migration.

### Domain Name Registration
- **.com**: ₹949/yr (Renewal ₹1,399/yr)
- **.in**: ₹399/yr (Renewal ₹799/yr)
- **.co.in**: ₹299/yr (Renewal ₹599/yr)
- **.org**: ₹1,199/yr (Renewal ₹1,499/yr)
- **.net**: ₹1,149/yr (Renewal ₹1,399/yr)
Includes WHOIS Privacy Protection, Instant DNS Management, and Auto-Renewal Safeguards.

### Google Workspace Solutions
- Official Business Email (@yourdomain.com)
- Google Drive Cloud Storage (Docs, Sheets, Slides)
- HD Google Meet Video Meetings & Google Calendar
- MX Record Verification & Technical Support

### Security & Add-ons
- Free Automated SSL Certificates (HTTPS Encryption)
- Wildcard SSL & Dedicated IPv4 Add-ons
- Automated Daily Snapshots & Web Application Firewall (WAF)
- Free Expert Website Migration with Zero Downtime
